news.headline: MAK Capital group discloses 7.8% passive ownership stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One and Michael A. Kaufman jointly reported 2,375,861 CLPT shares (7.8% of shares outstanding) with shared voting and dispositive power, up from a 6.3% stake disclosed earlier in the year. The increased passive stake signals continued institutional accumulation despite the post-earnings share-price collapse.

news.headline: Stifel cuts price target to $22 and Lake Street to $25, both keeping Buy after the Q2 miss
news.summary: Stifel trimmed its target from $25 to $22 and Lake Street from a higher level to $25, both maintaining Buy ratings after Q2 revenue of $10.9M came in roughly $1.8M below consensus and full-year guidance was cut about 7%. Shares fell another 16% in the Aug 4 session, extending the post-print decline to well under half the $30.10 52-week high.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9M (+18%), misses estimates and cuts FY guidance to $48-52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 18% to $10.9M but landed about $1.8M below the $12.7M consensus, with neurosurgery navigation and therapy up 62% to $5.6M while biologics and drug delivery fell 15% to $4.0M. Gross margin improved to 62%, yet opex jumped 51% to $17.0M, widening the net loss to $11.3M (adj. -$0.38 vs -$0.29 expected) and cutting cash to $29.4M from $45.9M at year-end; FY2026 guidance was lowered to $48-52M.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro investor slides lay out $500M long-term revenue target and CAL/ultrasound/robotics roadmap
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 print, management presented a five-pillar strategy targeting $500M in annual revenue, centred on cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain, the newly possessed 30,000 sq ft ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) site in Torrey Pines, the 10-year SONOCARE focused-ultrasound partnership, a cranial robot shaped by feedback from 50+ neurosurgeons, and Harmony software. CAL is framed as lifting preclinical service capacity from roughly $8M to over $60M annually, with the first GLP IND-enabling statement of work signed for completion in H1 2027.

news.headline: ClearPoint congratulates partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT designation for sasineprocel
news.summary: The FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation to Aspen's autologous dopaminergic cell therapy sasineprocel (ANPD001) for Parkinson's disease, based on the ongoing Phase 1/2a ASPIRO trial. The ClearPoint Navigation System and SmartFlow cannula are used for the transplantation procedure, so the designation, which brings potential priority review or accelerated approval, advances a second major partner program running on ClearPoint's platform; the stock rose about 3% on the news.

news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.1% beneficial ownership stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: BlackRock reported beneficial ownership of 2,118,912 CLPT shares, or 7.1% of the common stock, with sole voting power over 2,087,782 shares in an amended Schedule 13G. Together with MAK Capital's 7.8%, it puts roughly 15% of the float in the hands of two large passive holders ahead of the Q2 print.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure confirmed after its June 2026 Type B FDA meeting that the FDA will accept the 3-year Phase I/II analysis as the primary basis of a BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under accelerated approval, and that it intends to file in Q3 2026. ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation platform is the delivery system, making this the single most important partner milestone for the CLPT thesis and the nearest-dated one.

catalysts.label: Biologics and drug delivery back to growth via CAL
catalysts.detail: Management stated the CAL preclinical facility came into ClearPoint's possession in July and that new services revenue should return the biologics and drug delivery segment (down 15% to $4.0M in Q2) to growth in Q3. This is the first hard checkpoint on whether the guidance cut was a genuine timing shift or a demand problem.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx EPY201 Phase 1/2a start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx plans a first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial of EPY201 for focal refractory epilepsy using ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System, following the July 2026 partnership announcement. Trial initiation would convert the deal into actual procedure and service revenue.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience post-RMAT regulatory alignment
catalysts.detail: With RMAT designation in hand for sasineprocel, Aspen gains early and frequent FDA interactions and potential eligibility for accelerated approval in Parkinson's. Any announced pivotal trial design or expanded ASPIRO enrollment would add a second near-term approval pathway running on ClearPoint hardware.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly print, expected in early November 2026 (date not yet formally announced; the IR calendar shows no scheduled events as of mid-August). After the FY cut to $48-52M, cash down to $29.4M and opex up 51%, investors will focus on cash burn, whether opex growth moderates, and whether a capital raise becomes necessary.

catalysts.label: Partner trial ramp and roughly 10 data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to 10-15 clinical trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, plus roughly 10 partner data readouts. This is the core driver of the biologics and drug-delivery revenue line and the main evidence needed to validate the $500M long-term revenue ambition.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study completed at CAL; robotics prototypes in preclinical use
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint signed its first GLP statement of work for the CAL facility, targeted for completion in the first half of 2027, and expects functioning cranial robot prototypes to be used preclinically at CAL and to generate incremental service revenue in 2027. Delivering both would prove out the capacity expansion from roughly $8M to over $60M that underpins the new strategy.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Assuming a Q3 2026 filing with priority review, an FDA decision on the first Huntington's gene therapy could arrive around mid-2027. Approval would establish recurring per-procedure delivery revenue for ClearPoint and be the first commercial validation of the platform.

pulse: CLPT has traded quietly since mid-August, with no new price-moving news since the Aug 12 disclosure that MAK Capital raised its passive stake to 7.8%, following BlackRock's 7.1% stake filed in late July - together nearly 15% of the float held by patient institutional money accumulating into the post-earnings weakness. The stock remains well off its $30.10 52-week high after the August 3 print, when Q2 revenue of $10.9M missed by about $1.8M, opex jumped 51%, cash fell to $29.4M and FY2026 guidance was cut to $48-52M, even as management unveiled a $500M long-term revenue ambition built on gene-therapy delivery, the new CAL preclinical facility, the SONOCARE focused-ultrasound partnership and a cranial robot; Stifel and Lake Street both kept Buy ratings while trimming targets to $22-$25. The next catalysts are partner-driven rather than internal - uniQure's confirmed Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130 is the dominant near-term event, backed by Aspen's fresh RMAT in Parkinson's and the pending EpilepsyGTx trial start - with the Q3 2026 earnings print (expected early November) the next hard checkpoint on cash burn and whether biologics revenue reaccelerates as promised.
